structured_output.title: Restore the retry around flaky servo reads
structured_output.pattern: One flaky Present_Position read crashes the arm loop; raising an unread config value failed on sim-1, restoring the retry passed on sim-3.

proposal.markdown:
# Servo read error: restore the retry

When one flaky `Present_Position` read crashes the arm's job, the fix that held (sim-3, bench check passed) restored the retry around that read. Raising a config value that nothing reads (sim-1) did not.

1. Reproduce: run the arm job and look for one failed `Present_Position` read just before the crash.
2. Find that servo read in the control loop and check whether a retry wraps it.
3. Restore a bounded retry around that one read (3 tries, short backoff) and log each retry.
4. Verify with the bench check, not by watching one run: the job must survive injected flaky reads.
5. Don't raise `read_retries` in robot/config.toml unless the code reads it.
